=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:167-183 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: FIRST_ISSUE_LABELS_JSON is captured exclusively from the first linked issue_number (when FIRST_ISSUE is set), but FIRST_ISSUE_BODY continues to be sought from subsequent issues if the first has an empty body, decoupling the label source from the body source used as judge context.
  WHY: If the first linked issue has ai:orchestrator-managed label but empty body, the script propagates the label to the reissue (based on first issue labels) while feeding the judge a body from a later issue (echo "${FIRST_ISSUE_BODY}" as "original requirement"), leading to mismatched context for judge decision and potential incorrect label on reissue.
- tests/test_review_rb_judge_label_propagation.py:208-276 (_run_close_and_reissue), 138-143 (_build_harness with _safe_gh_jq stub), env["FIRST_ISSUE_LABELS_JSON"] | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Runtime tests (_run_close_and_reissue) pre-seed FIRST_ISSUE_LABELS_JSON via env var and stub _safe_gh_jq to ':' (noop), bypassing the actual jq extraction from GitHub issue JSON.
  WHY: jq filter breaks (e.g. GitHub .labels shape change, null labels) go undetected; tests pass with synthetic array input, but runtime label capture silently yields empty [] and skips propagation.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
